Description
ibis London City - Shoreditch
Vibrant economy hotel, open to everyone
ibis London City - Shoreditch is a vibrant Aldgate hotel where you can step out and be in the City, Liverpool Street or Brick Lane within minutes. Perfect for business and leisure stays, our colourful rooms feature 55-inch 4K TVs, allowing you to stream your own content, as well as complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi. Start your day with a full buffet breakfast or breakfast-to-go, then unwind at Charlie’s Corner with craft beers, cocktails and a varied menu featuring British classics and shareable platters.
Discover the best of London from our hotel near Shoreditch, just a 10-minute walk or one Tube stop away from Liverpool Street Station, and near Aldgate East. Explore vibrant Spitalfields Market, admire the Crown Jewels at the Tower of London, and enjoy vintage shopping in Shoreditch and Brick Lane, all within easy walking distance. Visit Tower Bridge, the O2 and ExCeL London, or take advantage of easy Tube connections to top-flight sports matches at Wembley Stadium and Tottenham Hotspur Stadium.
We are near Aldgate East (District and Hammersmith & City lines) and Aldgate (Circle and Metropolitan lines) Tubes, with a bus stop at our entrance. Our hotel is also convenient for London City Airport and the Eurostar from St Pancras International.
Welcome to our dynamic Shoreditch hotel! We're here to welcome you, serve up tasty bites and share insider tips for exploring Shoreditch and beyond. Whether you're seeing the sights or working hard in the City, we'll sync with your tempo during your stay. Elena Caraus, Hotel Management See more ibis London City - Shoreditch
Hotel information
Our hotel is now cashless! Only payment by credit or debit cards will be accepted.
Hotel extras
Hotel right next door to Aldgate East Tube station
Walking distance to Tower Bridge and major attractions
Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi in rooms, bar and lobby
Charlie's Corner bar and restaurant for meals & mixology
Green Key Certified – 100% committed to operating sustainably

Customer review rating 3.5/5
Gary B. Business

stay was ok, apart from the breakfase experience, which was disappointing. See more See more about the review from Gary B.
Customer review rating 2.0/5
Yuliya S. Couples
- 11/6/2026 Confirmed reviews ALL
This was the second-worst Ibis hotel I’ve ever stayed at—the first one was also in London. I specifically chose a more expensive room—£504 for three nights—expecting a higher floor with a view of London, which was very important to me. Instead, the view was mostly of the building next door. I’ve always associated the Ibis brand with predictability, quality, and safety, and I hoped for the same this time—but that certainly wasn’t the case. There was no safe in the room, and a notice on the door explicitly states that the hotel takes no responsibility for items left in the room. Seriously? Breakfast was also underwhelming; usually, it’s quite good, but not here—there wasn’t even any peanut butter.
To make matters worse, once you’ve checked out, you can’t even use the restroom on the ground floor because access requires a key card. That’s just absurd.
The only plus is the location, but even that doesn’t save it.
I won’t be choosing this hotel chain for my next trip. See more See more about the review from Yuliya S.
Customer review rating 3.0/5
De G. F. Business
- 11/6/2026 Confirmed reviews ALL
The staff was excellent. Everyone was really nice. The room was small, and the chair was folded out to act as an extra bed, and as there was already a double bed as well, there was no room to sit or walk. The room was very very hot and the fan/airco/thermostat was not able to reduce the temperature. Opening the window helped a little bit except the noise was so great it woke me up all the time. TV remote was missing. Dust everywhere. Did not tell the staff as I just wanted to rest. See more See more about the review from De G. F.
Customer review rating 4.0/5

Well equipped room. V clean. See more See more about the review from Paul R.

Your kind words will be shared with the team. We look forward to welcoming you back to ibis London Shoreditch soon!
Kind regards,
Gustavo - Front Desk Team Member
